_comment: Canonical CrossProbeOriginator.dispatchTo() resolutions for cxp_originate_hierarchy.v. Each scenario maps a selection (scope + element) to the canonical ElementId the outbound RequestHighlight carries and the expected CrossProbeDispatchResult. localPath is the human-readable selection path; expectedCanonical is the over-the-wire form the shared resolveCxpSelection funnel produces. 2026-07-26 cross-probe identity fix (verified against the live originator by test/verification/cxp_originate_fixture_sync_test.dart): dispatchTo now routes through resolveCxpSelection instead of buildElementPath, so every element goes over the wire as a CLEAN dot-joined hierarchical NAME with NO in-band marker — an instance is top.u_cpu (not top.u_cpu:cell), a boundary port is top.clk (not top:port:clk), and a net reverse-resolves to its declared name top.u_cpu.data_bus (not the opaque top.u_cpu:net:<edgeId> edge id). The ElementId.kind still distinguishes instance/port/net, so a receiver leaf-matches the trailing segment without parsing markers (the earlier 2026-07-19 marker forms were exactly what WaveCrux could not match). The §6 integration test + the sync test assert these against a capturing CXP server. Maintained in tool/generate_pro_verification_fixtures.dart.

scenarios.description: select the u_cpu instance at the top scope
select the clk port at the top scope
select the data_bus net inside the u_cpu scope
no active CXP server -> noServer, nothing dispatched
